title: Frappe ERPNext 12.2.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 12.2.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the Assets module. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal privileges or portal users, to access asset details beyond their authorized scope by sending crafted requests. The vulnerability does not affect confidentiality, integrity, or availability beyond unauthorized read access to asset details.
